verdict.rationale: Solid ships a first-party playground for running code ("Try this code in our playground!"), and its site hosts runnable examples, so runnable examples exist. Nothing shows an interactive API reference, meaning API docs with embedded runnable snippets. Hands-on reports describe a glitchy landing-page playground widget and site examples failing on Android Chrome, and one user calls the docs lacking. These are platform-specific glitches rather than a refutation of the playground. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive API reference with per-API runnable examples, reliable cross-device playground/example behavior, depth of first-party documentation.
